mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the heart and lungs to the chest was most worthwhile because the final cutaways connected muscle movement, airflow and blood flow.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the rib muscles was straightforward from the picture, but its result felt mostly like an intermediate assembly step.

surprise.text: The final explanation clarified that making more room lowers air pressure in the lungs, drawing air in.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary: the pictures and named slots made the pairings understandable.
